subject: Big Data & Cloud Computing
text: Which characteristic is commonly associated with a data warehouse?
optionA: Subject-oriented, integrated, time-variant and non-volatile data
optionB: Only temporary data that is deleted after each query
optionC: Data stored exclusively as source-code files
optionD: A database that accepts only one record
explanation: A traditional data warehouse is commonly described as subject-oriented, integrated, time-variant and non-volatile.

subject: Big Data & Cloud Computing
text: What is the primary role of the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS)?
optionA: To render web pages in a browser
optionB: To store large files across multiple machines in a cluster
optionD: To replace all relational query languages
explanation: HDFS distributes file blocks across machines and provides fault-tolerant storage for large datasets.

subject: Big Data & Cloud Computing
text: In MapReduce, what is the main responsibility of the reduce phase?
optionA: To collect and aggregate intermediate values associated with keys
optionC: To assign IP addresses to worker nodes
explanation: The reduce function processes grouped intermediate values for each key and produces aggregated output.

subject: Big Data & Cloud Computing
text: What does elasticity mean in cloud computing?
optionA: Resources can be scaled up or down as demand changes
optionB: Every customer must own a physical data center
optionD: A cloud service must run on a single computer
explanation: Elasticity allows computing resources to expand or contract in response to workload demand.

subject: Big Data & Cloud Computing
text: Which cloud service model provides a complete application for use over a network while the provider manages the underlying platform?
explanation: Software as a Service delivers a ready-to-use application; the provider operates the application and its supporting infrastructure.

subject: Big Data & Cloud Computing
text: What is a common objective of data mining?
optionA: To discover useful patterns and relationships in datasets
optionB: To guarantee that every record is correct
optionC: To replace data collection with manual typing
optionD: To remove all statistical variation from data
explanation: Data mining applies analytical methods to discover patterns, associations or useful structure in data.
